scope: Complete overview, four lessons and 16 objectives, four fictional practice cases and 12 choices, feedback, four knowledge checks, private reflection and actions, five flashcards, full job aid, fourteen source notes and cover description. Recordings are outside this review.
method: Read full source and final generated overview/job aid; compare relevant primary authorities, revise current referrals, historical records, eligibility, privacy and notice boundaries, inspect cover image, verify serialized readings and assessment distinctions.
findings: HSS ended October 31, 2025; remove current referrals, not historical or required records.
Housing Support requires an eligible person, provider and place; no automatic replacement after HSS.
Replaced broken DHS link and preserved usable offline contact routes.
No fixed address does not by itself end residency; responsible staff handle actual eligibility and service questions.
Tennessen notice includes known consequences of providing or refusing data and does not itself authorize later disclosures.
Returned-mail procedures and current source distinctions replace an assumption of immediate closure.
Court conditions, executive interpretation and draft state plan remain distinct.
Fictional cases and blank templates avoid unnecessary access to private records.
